result.description: A fictional high-capacity external archive dock designed for long-term offline backups, media libraries, and bulk project transfers. It features a USB-C 10Gbps interface, aluminum enclosure, shock-absorbing base, and tool-free drive bay access for quick swapping. Built around a generic storage controller, it emphasizes quiet operation, thermal stability, and broad desktop compatibility rather than gaming or workstation acceleration.
result.title: Aurora Vale 6TB Portable Archive Dock
